messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-gateway-prod" region=us-west-2 — 5xx error rate = 8.2% (2m window) :rotating_light: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD1234

 tim_oncall: ACKed. I'm taking this. Pulling up latency/error dash and logs now.

 devon: seeing a spike of 502/503 from upstream auth-proxy (pods auth-proxy-7f6b and auth-proxy-7f6c). Starts ~4m ago, aligns with a deploy at ~5m. Stack traces show TLS handshake failures upstream.

 alyssa: Support report: 3 customer tickets (EU) reporting 503s for inference POSTs. Marking potential customer impact.

 sara: quick repro from my laptop: ```for i in {1..5}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST https://api.prod.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'; sleep 1; done``` returns repeated 503/502 for me.

 matt: I can push a traffic-shift to route 15% of prod traffic to fallback-usw1 while we triage. Also preparing rollback of auth-proxy to v1.3.2.

 tim_oncall: Matt — please open the rollback PR and trigger the canary. I'll monitor error-rate and escalate if it doesn't improve in 3m.

 matt: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-deploys/pull/424 — initiating rollback canary now. Kicking the traffic-shift (15% to fallback).

 devon: kvcache miss rate is high on the fallback nodes (warming). Expect transient latency but should mitigate 5xx once upstream stabilizes.

 incident-bot: Note: escalation policy (infra-sre) will be notified in 5m if no further ACK or mitigation updates.

 tim_oncall: error-rate dropped to 3.1% over 1m after traffic-shift + rollback canary. Still above baseline but trending down. Keeping oncall.

 alyssa: I'll draft a short customer update: "We detected a transient increase in 5xx errors affecting inference POSTs in US-West. We've shifted traffic and rolled back a recent auth-proxy deploy; we're monitoring. Estimated recovery window: 30 minutes." Sending to support.

 sara: double-checked embeddings and reranking routes — stable (0.2% errors). Seems contained to POST inference path through auth-proxy.

 devon: logs show repeated backend TLS timeout handshake to upstream cert issuer; adding a temporary circuit-breaker rule to drop flapping upstream hosts.

 tim_oncall: plan: 1) Keep rollback in canary and expand if green, 2) keep traffic-shift until error-rate <1% for 5m, 3) infra to look at TLS cert renewal chain. If stable, we'll hand off to morning shift.

 matt: expanding rollback to 60% canary now. Noted on runbook.

 tim_oncall: error-rate now 0.8% over 2m. Holding for 5m window before closing PD. Will stay on thread for handoff. :thumbsup:

 incident-bot: PD incident PD1234 will be automatically closed if incident condition clears for configured window.

 alyssa: support notified customers with initial message and ETA. Will update when we have full RCA.

 tim_oncall: ok to handoff to morning shift once we meet the <1% for 5m and infra confirms certificate/upsream fix.

 sara: verifying edge headers now — no anomalies besides retried upstream TLS.

 matt: leaving a postmortem stub: https://go.redwood/incident/PD1234 — filling in details.

 tim_oncall: thanks everyone. I'll create the follow-up ticket for certificate rotation and auth-proxy deploy gating. Closing thread after handoff.
